versions.name: Louisiana Swamp Base

features.note: A sixty-one-mile canoe trek through the Atchafalaya Swamp over six days.
Wetland ecology instruction and conservation service learning.
Free-time fishing on the bayous and lakes along the trail.
Hammocks with built-in mosquito nets for the primitive island night.
Floating campsites sit under a roofed pavilion.
Most overnight stops have 110-volt power; the first two nights do not.
Crews cook their own meals at each overnight camp on a propane stove.
A provisional crew places individual Scouts from across the country together.

versions.summary: High-adventure and conservation program run by the Evangeline Area Council, immersing crews in paddling treks through the Atchafalaya Swamp.
